name: security-boundary
instructions: The Lambda is the public entry point. verifySlackSignature must run on every /slack/events and /slack/commands request before any work, with its 300-second timestamp window against replay. ChannelRateLimiter is per channel only and sets a holdoff flag the agent reads; there is no per-user limit, so do not report its absence. Nothing from the request may reach a shell, a query or a log unescaped.

name: model-and-secrets
instructions: API keys and tokens come only from the environment or Secrets Manager and never reach a log, a Slack message or a tool result. The /squirrel-admin check output shows at most a key prefix. Model ID and provider settings are read in one place; read the code on the head commit for the current provider and do not assume one. Env passed to the SDK subprocess or to an MCP server (mcpServers in agent.ts) must not give that process a secret it does not use.

name: agent-tools
instructions: The agent acts for Slack users. allowedTools in packages/agent/src/agent.ts is the tool allowlist; a new tool, especially a write tool, must be named in the PR and justified. url_fetch serves only URLs that match the admin-managed allowlist exactly or by a '*' prefix (UrlConfig.isAllowed); a change that loosens that match is a bug. A prompt-injected document must not be able to widen what the agent can do.

name: admin-commands
instructions: /squirrel-admin changes behaviour for everyone. The Lambda (handleCommand in packages/lambda/src/index.ts) checks the caller against ADMIN_USER_IDS before it replies or queues anything; packages/agent/src/admin.ts trusts that check. A new subcommand must go through the same path. Replies must not echo secrets or other users' private data.

name: migrations
instructions: The deploy runs the migration task before the new Lambda and agent start, while the old versions still run. Schema changes must work with both: add before you use, never rename or drop in the same release. A change to schema.ts needs a generated migration in packages/db/drizzle and a matching change to schema-sqlite.ts.

name: deploy
instructions: Deploy and CI changes: secrets referenced must exist, permissions stay minimal, and a dev deploy must not be able to touch prod.
